system.description: Base Essence (Elemental Companion) 5.13.1 - Elemental Channels. Contaminating water with elemental material, a beam that starts converting the target's flesh into raw elemental material at increasing critical severity (Elemental Channel I-V/True), stunning and sleep channeled directly from the caster's deity, tearing a target's soul from its body (Absolutions), transmitting a spell of increasing level to a distant receiver instead of casting it directly (Channels I/III/V/VIII/X, up to Lord Channels), and finally a Deific Gate opening direct communion with the caster's deity. Fidelity notes: levels 2, 8, 12, 13, 16, and 17 are intentionally blank in the source (no spell printed); level 19 (Channels X) is printed in the table with no Area of Effect/Duration/Range/Type at all - reconstructed here as "1 spell / — / varies / U" to match every other spell in the Channels I/III/V/VIII family exactly; level 25 (Elemental Channels True) is printed with only three of its four stat columns - the missing Duration was reconstructed as "—" to match the Elemental Channel I-V family it belongs to.

Caster Channels his deity's energy into a small amount of water, contaminating it with elemental material. Targets in contact with the water will take an 'A' critical of the appropriate type (Impact if they infuse it with Elemental Water). If splashed on a target, make a d100 roll with the following results: 1-25: A critical at -50; 26-50: A critical at -20; 51+ A critical.

[RR Mod: -10] Caster points his hand at target and a blast of raw power from the caster's Deity flows forth. Target struck by beam must resist or have part of itself turn into Elemental Material. Exposure is such that the target receives an 'A' critical of the appropriate type if he fails his Resistance Roll.

When this spell is cast, the first level spell that the caster begins to cast the next round will be "channeled" to another spell user of the Channeling realm or another spell user who has specialized in the same element as the caster. The "channeled" spell is transmitted to the other spell user when it would normally take effect, and must be used by the receiving spell user immediately (i.e., the receiving spell user is now treated as the caster of the spell.) All normal restrictions apply to the transmitted spell. The caster of the Channels spell must be able to see the receiver of the spell or know exactly where he is (direction and distance, or specified location). The receiver must know exactly when the spell is coming (though he need not know exactly what spell is coming). For example, if an Elemental Priest was at a certain altar at midnight on a full moon ready to receive a spell, then another spell user who knew this could use Channels to send him a spell.
Caster points his arm (elbow locked and fist clenched) at the target and channels raw power from his power source (usually a Deity or Lord). The target of the spell is stunned.
[RR Mod: -10] As Elemental Channel I, except the target receives a 'B' critical of the appropriate type.
As Channels I, except up to a third level spell may be transmitted.

Caster points his arm (elbow locked and fist clenched) at the target and channels raw power from his power source (usually a deity.) The target of the spell falls into a deep sleep. The first minute of this sleep is magical (and the target cannot be awakened in any normal fashion.) After the first minute, the target may be awakened normally (though his deep sleep will prevent him from waking on his own until he has slept a full eight hours.)
[RR Mod: -10] As Elemental Channel I, except the target receives a 'C' critical of the appropriate type.
As Channels I, except up to a fifth level spell may be transmitted.
[RR Mod: -10] As Elemental Channel I, except the target receives a 'D' critical of the appropriate type.
As Channels I, except up to a eighth level spell may be transmitted.
[RR Mod: -10] As Elemental Channel I except target receives an 'E' critical of the appropriate type.
As Channels I, except up to a tenth level spell may be transmitted.

[RR Mod: -20] Target's "soul" is torn from his body; it remains in whatever place "souls" go for the duration of the spell. The soul can be returned early only through Lifegiving. The target is unconscious until the soul is restored. Even subconscious activities (i.e., healing, etc.) suffer a -75 penalty.
[RR Mod: -10] As Elemental Channel I except target is completely converted into the caster's element, killing him. All within 5' of target take an 'A' critical of the appropriate type.
As Channels I, except up to a twentieth level spell may be transmitted.
Opens a direct channel to the caster's deity; results depend on the deity's personality, motives, and powers. Any spell the deity can cast may be transmitted through the gate.
